name: Den's long room deep in the pyramid
about: The narrow, long room behind a sealed door deep in the pyramid where Den receives Zei and Gladias (chapters 9, 10 and 24). The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: He had never been this deep into the depths of the mountain pyramid before.
he got to a sealed door with a green circle beside it
facts.fact: A sealed door with a green circle.

facts.quote: Behind the door, there was a narrow and long room, and at the end of the room there was a large table.
facts.fact: A narrow, long room with a large table at the far end.

facts.quote: Gladias and Zei walked down the tunnel, and down the stairs.

descriptor: a narrow, very long windowless room hewn deep inside a mountain, rough-cut rock walls above a floor of polished stone, a heavy sealed door with a glowing green circle beside it at one end, and at the far end a single large dark table under a pool of warm lamplight, the rest falling away into dim shadow
